card.text: M5 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 7,480 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 5 or M5 is a globular cluster in the constellation Serpens.

introduction.text: M5 is drawn as 5,883 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
